description.value: Fresh St. Market Vancouver House is a full-service grocery store situated within the Vancouver House mixed-use development in central Vancouver. It stocks an extensive range of fresh, local, and specialty foods spanning produce, deli, seafood, bakery, and prepared meals. For touring cyclists, it represents a well-stocked urban resupply point with broad grocery selection.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 12m; stands (2 spaces) at 14m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 30m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (4 spaces) at 64m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m. Total: 16 spaces.
